purpose: The producer behind the homepage reading module. Every 'published' entry must resolve to a reviewed page that App.tsx serves with its own component; scripts/content-promise-gate.mjs fails the build if any entry resolves to a withdrawn route. A 'withdrawn' entry is rendered as a labelled withdrawal record, never as ready reading.
